verdict.rationale: Muse is a hosted agent service, and the existence of an api.muse.ai origin shows a published API spec is a fair question, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The runtime probe found that https://muse.ai/openapi.json returned 401 and api.muse.ai exposes no spec or discovery route, so there is no public machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
